name: agent-vision-recreation
description: Recreation of a reference video's format with your own assets, driven by src/storyboard.json.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Main out/video.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted && remotion render src/index.ts Main out/audio.wav --codec=wav && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i out/video.mp4 -i out/audio.wav -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v copy -af apad -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/final.mp4
